title: Scorecard Holder
body: For the golfer who wants to disconnect, leave the GHIN App or 18 Birdies in the bag and do it how it used to be done. Fits most standard scorecards and easily fits into a back pocket. Clasp securely holds stacks of dollar bills - if you are into that sort of thing. Black Full Grain Leather Complimentary Navy thread Made here in Denver

title: Tee Ring
body: 178 yard Par 3, down wind and you got the 7 iron in your hard. Your playing partners are waiting for you to throw a dart, and you have no tee. The worst. Keep them close by, throw a handful on this handy little key ring so you aren’t left hunting for that ‘perfect’ broken tee up at the box. Black Full Grain Leather Complimentary Navy thread Fits up to 4 Tees Made here in Denver

title: The Quilted Pouch
body: Significant other ever get a tiny bit upset when you’re gone for eight hours on a Saturday golfing with the fellas? Likely. We kind of solved it with this Valuables Pouch though because these special pouches are made by my wife at Queen City Quilt Co.. If you’re going to be gone, make sure you are carrying little bit of them with you! Drawstring closure to keep valuables inside Two Tone - Black/Navy Fits up 39 tees, 17 ball markers, five repair tools and three balls Made here in Denver

title: Hammered Copper Repair Tool
body: In collaboration with my good buddy Chuck, we wanted to craft the perfect Repair Tool that will only get better with age. Handmade and hammered with the gentlest hands, these tools aren’t going anywhere - now let’s hope they help you on the green. ‘MS’ stamp on the front ‘DS’ stamp on the back Made in Georgia

title: Hammered Brass Repair Tool
body: In collaboration with my good buddy Chuck, we wanted to craft the perfect Repair Tool that will only get better with age. Handmade and hammered with the gentlest hands, these tools aren’t going anywhere - now let’s hope they help you on the green. ‘MS’ stamp on the front ‘DS’ stamp on the back Made in Georgia

title: The Bag Tag
body: Toss it on your travel bag, throw it on your Sunday Bag or add it to your favorite duffel. It’s all about the little things that add flare and get the conversations going. Add your address to the inside and rest a little easier. Black Full Grain Leather Complimentary Navy thread Made here in Denver

title: Staple Sunglass Case
body: The little things matter, all the way down to making sure the specs are protected. Throw it in that weird extra pocket in your bag for when the sun starts hiding and feel good. Like everything else from Magpie Supply, watch this case patina and look better over time. Crafted using ‘Rough Out’ leather Complimentary Navy thread Made here in Denver

title: The Magpie x RossCo Headcover
body: Crafted in Bandon, Oregon by Rossco Golf. Nice clubs deserve nicer sleeping bags and these are just that. Those first tee jitters are still going to be there, but no chance Carl doesn’t recognize how cool your Driver Headcover is. Magpie on the crown Aqua Blue Crown Pendleton Grey Shaft Fits Drivers and 3 Woods

title: The Staple 5 Panel
body: Classic 5 Panel hat. Wear it on the course, or throw it on for a dog walk. It’s white, because we want to see it worn and we want to see that ring of sweat. Golf is not easy, neither is that four footer - don’t sweat it. Adjustable closure Magpie Logo on the front / MS Logo on the side Crafted here in Colorado

title: Staple Sun Shirt
body: The perfect long sleeve for early mornings, steamy days in the sun or that twilight nine hole round. The ‘SSS’ is lightweight and ideal for protecting against those pesky UV Rays. Stand out on the course Features left chest logo and word mark on the cuff Lightweight hood for additional UV coverage Made here in the USA
